ios.desc:
Start or join plans in seconds — from coffee to travel.

Find people for anything:
- bars & cafes
- sports & activities
- movies & events
- trips & travel
- networking

No swiping. No endless chats. Just real plans.

Create a plan in seconds. See who’s joining before you go. Chat only when it matters. Meet in real life.

Real people only. No bots.
Mandatory selfie verification means you always know who you’re meeting — safer, more authentic, and no fake profiles.

Not a dating app. No pressure, no awkward flirting, no endless texting — just people who want to do things together.

Works anywhere. New in the city? Traveling? Or just bored tonight? There’s always something to join.

Meet more people in a week than on dating apps
Finally an app where people actually meet
Perfect when you move to a new city

Free to start.

android.desc:
Invitor — will help you find friends and like-minded people to go to a cafe, a bar, a concert, a movie or to walk around the city. If you have a question "Who would @any_activity be with?" then download our app.

IT WORKS EVERYWHERE: Thousands of people from dozens of countries around the world find friends in our app every day! People from hundreds of cities actively use Invitor

IT's SIMPLE: you make a post, for example, "Let's go for a walk," "Who's going to the movies with me?" or "I want to go to the bar." Your offer will be seen by others, they will show interest and you agree on the details in the chat.

TOP VIEW: we have revived the city map and moved all the activity there so that you understand who is next to you is also looking for company.

PRIVACY: Open and private events can be created in Invitor — they can only be accessed with approval. If you don't want anyone to see your event except subscribers, then you can change the visibility.

IT IS IMPORTANT: everyone needs communication, and it is not easy to find a enjoyable and adequate companion. Dating, chat-roulette, theme groups cannot help you find a company quickly because they are not designed for this. In our app, everything is focused on a convenient company search.

UPDATES: Our team is constantly working on the convenience, speed and stability of the app.

If you have any ideas, questions or suggestions for cooperation, then write to us at service@invitor.com

quotes.text:
Hi HN! Thanks for taking a look at Invitor. An invitations feed from nearby people looking for company for everyday leisure (coffee, bars, concerts, movies, city walks), not dating.

What to try (2 minutes):

Open the app and browse the invitations feed for your city.

Join an invite or post a quick one (“Walk in the park?”, “Who’s up for a movie?”).

Coordinate details in the built-in group chat.

Optional: switch to the map if you want to see what’s nearby.

Questions we’d love your honest take on:

Would you use this? Why/why not?

Did you download it (iOS/Android)? Any install or sign-in friction?

First run: was it clear what to do next? Time to first join/post?

What’s missing for you (e.g., distance controls, RSVP caps, trust signals, moderation tools)?

Any trust/safety or “this feels awkward” concerns?

Bugs, slow parts, or empty-city experience?

service@invitor.com
